en.headline: Police and Hospital Authority sign MoU on counter-terrorism medical collaboration
en.dek: Commissioner Raymond Siu and HA chief executive Libby Lee signed the agreement covering tactical medical training, on-scene procedures and professional accreditation.
body: The Hong Kong Police Force and the Hospital Authority signed a memorandum of understanding on Wednesday to deepen collaboration on counter-terrorism response and medical functions.

Commissioner of Police Raymond Siu and Hospital Authority Chief Executive Libby Lee signed the document, marking a strategic partnership. The MoU covers tactical medical training, on-scene treatment procedures and professional accreditation, aiming to institutionalise the framework for high-risk incidents so that both sides can respond quickly, safely and effectively to mass-casualty or sudden critical events.
A joint demonstration by the Counter Terrorism Response Unit and the Fire Services Department’s special support team was also staged during the ceremony.

zh.headline: 警方與醫管局簽署諒解備忘錄 深化反恐應變及醫療協作
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴與醫管局行政總裁李夏茵簽署文件，涵蓋戰術醫療訓練、現場處置程序及專業認證等範疇。
body: 警務處與醫院管理局周三簽署諒解備忘錄，標誌雙方建立策略性夥伴關係，深化反恐應變及醫療職能上的協作與銜接。
警務處處長周一鳴與醫管局行政總裁李夏茵代表簽署。備忘錄涵蓋戰術醫療訓練、現場處置程序及專業認證等範疇，旨在制度化雙方在高危事故中的協作框架，確保面對大規模傷亡或突發危難時，雙方能迅速、安全及有效地執行緊急救援。
簽署儀式現場亦展示反恐特勤隊與消防處特別支援隊在應對反恐事故下的聯合演練。
